units.source_text: 匆匆过了三月二十。

en.t: The twentieth day of the third month quickly passed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王约定的那人家定于二十八日动身赴任国。

en.t: The household with whom Prince Niou had made the arrangement was scheduled to leave for the province on the twenty-eighth.

units.source_text: 匂亲王给浮舟的信上说：“是日夜间我定当前来迎接。

en.t: In his letter to Ukifune, Prince Niou wrote, "That night I will certainly come to fetch you.

units.source_text: 望即早做准备，勿使仆从窥破形迹。

en.t: Please make preparations early, and do not let the servants discover any sign of it.

units.source_text: 此间严守秘密，绝不走漏风声，请勿怀疑。”

en.t: I am keeping everything strictly secret here, and not a word will leak out; please do not doubt me."

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“亲王微服而来，此间戒备森严，势必不能与我再见一面，

en.t: Ukifune thought, "Even if the prince comes in disguise, with such strict watch kept here, he surely will not be able to see me once more,

units.source_text: 而徒劳往返，真乃可悲之事！

en.t: and he will only make the journey there and back in vain. How sad that would be!

units.source_text: 有什么办法可以相叙片刻呢？

en.t: Is there any way we could speak together, even for a moment?

units.source_text: 只得让他抱恨空归了。”

en.t: I can only let him go home empty-handed, full of regret."

units.source_text: 匂亲王的面影又片刻不离地出现在她眼前。

en.t: Prince Niou's image appeared before her eyes again, never leaving her for even a moment.

units.source_text: 不堪其悲，便拿起那封信来遮掩了颜面。

en.t: Unable to bear the sorrow, she picked up that letter and covered her face with it.

units.source_text: 暂时隐忍一下，终于扬声大哭。

en.t: She held herself in for a while, but at last burst into loud sobs.

units.source_text: 右近连忙劝解：“哎呀，小姐啊！

en.t: Ukon hurriedly tried to comfort her, saying, "Oh, my lady!

units.source_text: 你这样子，将被人家看出内情了。

en.t: If you go on like this, people will see what is really happening.

units.source_text: 已经渐渐有人怀疑了呢。

en.t: Some people are already beginning to suspect something.

units.source_text: 你不要只管悲伤，应该好好地写回信给他。

en.t: You must not only keep grieving; you should write him a proper reply.

units.source_text: 有我右近在这里，无论何事都不怕。

en.t: With me, Ukon, here beside you, there is nothing to fear.

units.source_text: 你这么小小的一个身体，即使要从空中飞行，亲王也能带走你。”

en.t: With such a small little body as yours, even if you had to fly through the air, the prince could carry you away."

units.source_text: 浮舟略微镇静一下，拭泪答道：“你们只管说我爱慕他，真使我伤心！

en.t: Ukifune grew a little calmer, wiped her tears, and answered, "You all keep saying that I long for him, and it truly pains me!

units.source_text: 如果事实如此，由你们说吧。

en.t: If that were really true, then you might say so.

units.source_text: 可是我一向认为此事荒唐之极。

en.t: But I have always thought this whole matter utterly absurd.

units.source_text: 只是那人蛮不讲理，硬说我爱慕他。

en.t: It is only that he is so unreasonable and insists that I love him.

units.source_text: 我倘坚决拒绝，不知他会做出何等可怕的事情来。

en.t: If I firmly refused him, I do not know what terrible thing he might do.

units.source_text: 我每念及此，痛感自身命苦！”

en.t: Whenever I think of this, I feel bitterly how unfortunate my fate is!"

units.source_text: 她把匂亲王的信置之不复。

en.t: She left Prince Niou's letter unanswered.
